issues.t: Distributor shaft seizing (stalls or will not start)
issues.sym: The engine cuts out in traffic, runs rough, or cranks but will not start. It may restart after cooling down, then quit again.
issues.why: First-generation trucks use a distributor, and its shaft bearing can rust and bind. As it drags, ignition timing and spark become erratic until the engine dies.
issues.next: Do not rely on the truck until it is fixed, since it can stall in traffic. Have the ignition system checked and replace the distributor if the shaft is binding.

issues.t: Cracked exhaust manifold (3.3L)
issues.sym: A ticking or puffing sound from the engine bay, louder when cold, sometimes with an exhaust smell or a check engine light.
issues.why: The manifold, most often on the right side, can crack or lose its studs after years of heating and cooling. Nissan published a service bulletin for this ticking noise.
issues.next: Have the manifold inspected. It is not an emergency, but fix it before exhaust fumes start reaching the cab or the leak grows.

issues.t: Lower steering shaft joint can corrode (recall)
issues.sym: Steering may feel stiff or notchy, especially at full lock during slow turns or parking.
issues.why: Road salt can rust the lower steering shaft joint. A badly corroded joint can crack and cause loss of steering control at low speed. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away and have the shaft inspected. If the steering binds or feels unusual, do not drive it until it is checked.

issues.t: Coolant leaking into the automatic transmission
issues.sym: Shuddering, slipping, or harsh shifts, and transmission fluid that looks pink and milky. Coolant may also go low.
issues.why: The transmission cooler built into the radiator can crack inside, letting coolant and transmission fluid mix and ruining the transmission. Nissan extended radiator warranty coverage on many of these trucks after a class action.
issues.next: Stop driving if it slips badly. Have the radiator and fluid checked right away. If the original radiator is still in place, many owners replace it as prevention.

issues.t: Timing chain whine (4.0L)
issues.sym: A high-pitched whine or buzz from the front of the engine that rises with engine speed. Later it can rattle or set timing-related codes.
issues.why: The plastic guides and tensioner shoes for the timing chains wear quickly and can break apart. Nissan issued a service bulletin covering the noise.
issues.next: Have it diagnosed soon. Replacing the chains, guides and tensioners before a guide breaks avoids much more serious engine damage.

issues.t: Front crash zone sensor corrosion (recall)
issues.sym: The air bag warning light comes on.
issues.why: Water and road salt can corrode the front crash zone sensor, which can prevent the front air bags from deploying correctly. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the sensor replaced. Treat an air bag light as a real fault until it is checked.

issues.t: Engine control relay can stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving, sometimes without warning, and may restart after a moment.
issues.why: Oxide can build up on the contacts of a relay that powers the engine controls, cutting power to the engine. Nissan recalled affected trucks to replace the relay.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get it done before regular driving, because a stall at speed is dangerous.

issues.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong (sending unit)
issues.sym: The gauge sticks, reads full or empty when it is not, the distance-to-empty display goes blank, and the check engine light may come on.
issues.why: The fuel level sending unit inside the tank wears and sends a false reading.
issues.next: Track mileage between fill-ups so you do not run dry, and have the sending unit tested and replaced.

issues.t: Fuel tank can deform and fool the gauge (recall)
issues.sym: The gauge shows fuel left, often around a quarter tank, when the tank is actually empty, and the truck runs out of gas.
issues.why: The fuel tank on certain trucks can deform so the gauge cannot read the true level. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Until it is done, refuel early and do not trust a low gauge reading.

issues.t: Fuel tank can deform and fool the gauge (recall)
issues.sym: The gauge shows fuel left, often around a quarter tank, when the tank is actually empty, and the truck runs out of gas.
issues.why: The fuel tank on certain trucks can deform so the gauge cannot read the true level. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Until it is done, refuel early and do not trust a low gauge reading.

issues.t: Rear axle seal leaks
issues.sym: Gear oil on the inside of a rear wheel or tire, a wet brake backing plate, weak rear braking, or grinding from the rear axle.
issues.why: The rear axle shaft seals can leak, sometimes because a clogged axle vent lets pressure build. Leaking oil can soak the rear brakes and starve the axle bearings. Nissan issued a service bulletin on these leaks.
issues.next: Have the seals replaced and the vent checked. Replace any oil-soaked brake parts, and top up the axle oil so the bearings and gears are not damaged.

issues.t: Steering wheel emblem can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs before a crash.
issues.why: The emblem on the driver air bag cover can crack and break off when the air bag deploys, and could strike the driver. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the free repair done.

issues.t: Weak lower control link welds (recall)
issues.sym: Usually none before a failure. A separated link would make the truck handle poorly or pull unexpectedly.
issues.why: Some lower control links on trucks built in late 2009 and early 2010 had welds below specification that could separate. Nissan recalled them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the links inspected or replaced before relying on the truck.

issues.t: Front wheel hubs may crack on 2WD trucks (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk, wobble, or new noise from a front wheel. In the worst case the wheel can separate.
issues.why: Some two-wheel-drive trucks built in mid-2012 got front hubs that were not hardened enough and could crack. Nissan recalled them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If you notice a wobble or clunk from the front, stop driving and have it inspected.

issues.t: Backward circuit breaker can short the wiring (recall)
issues.sym: Electrical items may stop working, and a short can cause a burning smell or smoke.
issues.why: A circuit breaker could be installed backward, letting the wiring harness rub against it until it shorts. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If you smell burning wires, stop and have the truck inspected before driving again.

issues.t: Starter wiring can short on the heat shield (recall)
issues.sym: Possible burning smell, smoke from under the truck, or starting trouble.
issues.why: On some V6 trucks built in early 2016, the starter cable could touch the heat shield and short out, creating a fire risk. Nissan recalled them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get it done promptly. If you smell burning, stop and have it inspected.

issues.t: Ignition can slip out of Run and stall (recall)
issues.sym: The engine suddenly shuts off while driving, often after the key or key ring is bumped, and power steering and brake assist are lost.
issues.why: On trucks with a turn key, the ignition switch can move from Run to Accessory too easily. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Until it is fixed, remove heavy items from the key ring and keep your knees clear of the key.

issues.t: Rear camera image can be switched off (recall)
issues.sym: No backup camera picture when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: The display settings could be changed so the rear view stays off, which breaks federal camera rules. Nissan recalled affected trucks for an update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Until then, check mirrors and look behind you when backing up.

issues.t: Park may not engage and the truck can roll away (recall)
issues.sym: The truck rolls after the shifter is placed in Park, sometimes several feet before it stops.
issues.why: The parking pawl in the 9-speed automatic may not engage fully. Nissan recalled these trucks, first for parts and then for a transmission software update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls. Until they are done, always set the parking brake and confirm the truck is held before getting out.

issues.t: Rough or erratic shifting (9-speed automatic)
issues.sym: Harsh or delayed shifts, gear hunting on the highway, clunks at low speed, hesitation when pulling away, or a gear-shaped warning or AT Check light.
issues.why: Owners widely report shift-quality problems with the 9-speed automatic. Dealers often address them with transmission software updates, and some have replaced the shifter.
issues.next: Have the dealer scan for codes and check for software updates. Get it looked at sooner if a warning light comes on or the truck stalls.

issues.t: Tire inner bead can tear (recall)
issues.sym: A sudden loss of air in a tire, which can cause a blowout or loss of control.
issues.why: The inner bead area of the tires fitted to some trucks could tear. These tires were recalled.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the tires inspected or replaced. Stop safely if a tire suddenly loses air.

issues.t: Front lower ball joint can corrode and separate (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or loose feeling from the right front, or wandering steering. A separated joint can cause loss of steering control.
issues.why: The ball joint on the right front lower link could corrode and pull apart. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get it done before regular driving. Stop driving if you notice new front-end clunks or loose steering.

issues.t: Backup camera may show a blank screen (recall)
issues.sym: The center screen stays blank when the truck is put in reverse.
issues.why: A software problem could stop the rear camera image from displaying. Nissan recalled affected trucks for a software update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Until it is done, check mirrors and look behind you when backing up.

issues.t: Daytime running lights dim after auto stop-start (recall)
issues.sym: The daytime running lights go dim for a while after the engine restarts from an automatic stop.
issues.why: A software error affects the lights after an idle stop-start restart. Nissan recalled affected trucks for an update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the update done at your next dealer visit.

issues.t: Door striker welds can break (recall)
issues.sym: A door may not latch firmly, rattle, or feel loose when closed.
issues.why: Some door strikers were poorly welded and could crack or separate, which could let a door open while driving. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have it repaired promptly. If a door will not latch securely, do not carry passengers in that seat until it is fixed.
